card.name: Step sizes in dose titration wording
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "by", "in", "at" or "increasing" right before a step amount in dose-change instructions. These come after phrases like decrease the dose, taper, or increase at intervals.

modes.label: Reduce or taper by an amount
modes.description: The word "by" or a gap right after a dose reduction or taper phrase, before the amount.
modes.example: Decrease the daily dose<< by>> 25 mg. Wait 2

modes.label: Increase in steps or intervals
modes.description: A linking or verb word in stepwise increase wording, before the size or timing of the step.
modes.example: increasing at one week intervals<< by>> 5 to 10 mg/kg

card.writes: It suppresses words meaning gradually or progressively, so it seems to stand in for the stepwise idea already given by the text.
card.plain: It marks the spot in dosing instructions where the text is about to say how much to raise or lower the dose each step.
